sentences.text: Pearl is a fictional character from the 2013 animated series Steven Universe , created by Rebecca Sugar .	Steven Universe	Steven Universe	Rebecca Sugar	Rebecca Sugar	animated series	animated series	Steven	Steven Universe (character)
She is a `` Gem '' , a fictional alien being that exists as a magical gemstone projecting a holographic body .	gemstone	gemstone
She is portrayed as a loving , gentle and delicate character , who acts as a motherly figure for Steven .	Steven	Steven Universe (character)

However , she also tends to be overprotective with him and has low self-esteem ; she is also deeply overwhelmed with the grief caused by the loss of Steven 's mother , Rose Quartz , who she was in love with .	Steven	Steven Universe (character)	Rose Quartz	List of Steven Universe characters#Rose Quartz
She is frequently praised for being a positive depiction of a queer character , though her strong obsession with Rose has been described as `` unhealthy '' .	queer	queer
